elsewhere:termite_queen: How to get: Mother Creak drops it (50%). Crafts the Termite Hive Lantern with Amber and a lantern.

elsewhere:tyrants_tusk: A diamond-strength golden axe; piglins stay neutral while you hold it.

Dropped by Grunthar & Ashtusk, the Gilded Tyrant and his war-hoglin (Tier I, Nether: the Treasure Hall of a bastion, with lava falls and a gold hoard).

elsewhere:unblinking_eye: Freezes every Stillness mob within 24 blocks for 8 s, even when you look away (bosses aren't affected). 16 uses, 30 s cooldown.
How to get: Sap Tapper trade: 6 Heartwood Shards and an ender eye.
elsewhere:undertow: A Loyalty III trident: hits pull the target 3 blocks toward you (4 s cooldown), and it works like Riptide when you're in water.

Dropped by Vorlagh, the Tidewrack Kraken (Tier III, Overworld: the Wreck Ring, three shipwrecks lashed into a deck island in deep ocean).
Summon Vorlagh: Blow a Siren Conch (dropped by Tidewrack Drowned) on the deck during a thunderstorm.
elsewhere:updraft_vent: A calcite grate that blows players upward.

elsewhere:verdigris_eel: Verdigris Eel: the fish caught in the Verdigris Sea. Eating it restores 3 hunger and gives Water Breathing for 30 seconds.

elsewhere:verdigris_gear: Verdigris Sea currency and a ritual ingredient.

elsewhere:verdigris_mitre: The best Diving Suit helmet: as tough as netherite, lots of extra air, and Conduit Power near copper underwater. Counts toward the Diving Suit set bonus.

elsewhere:village_ash: Ash left where a siege burned a village. The restore command clears it.
elsewhere:village_charred_planks: Burnt planks from a besieged village. Restoring the village brings the originals back.
elsewhere:village_royal_coffer: The iron-bound job site of the Royal Steward, the kingdom's former tax collector, who surrendered when the village was liberated and stayed on.

Serfs build it into the tax office of a fortified town. It cannot be crafted and drops nothing when broken, so a Steward exists only in towns you really liberated: at most one per town. A jobless villager can take the job the vanilla way if the Steward dies.

Royal Steward trades (Crowns): cosmetics 24-48 and Bodkin Bolts x8 for 32 (Novice); Oathkeeper's Seal 256, one per week (Expert); enchanted books Sharpness V, Protection IV, Efficiency V or Unbreaking III, 192 Crowns + 4 emerald blocks each, 2 of the 4 per Steward, restock weekly (Master); Netherite Upgrade Template 320 Crowns + 24 diamonds, one per week (Master). Master needs at least 2 Lords dead.
elsewhere:village_royal_purse: The seized village treasury, handed back after a liberation.
elsewhere:void_scale: Smithing piece that fuses a netherite chestplate and an elytra into the Void-Scale Elytra.

Dropped by Aphelion, the Coil Beyond the End (Tier VI, The End: the Shattered Halo, a ring of floating end-stone islands around an obsidian spire).
Summon Aphelion: Place the dragon egg on the spire altar with 4 end crystals. You get the egg back afterward. Best done after Ossyra.
elsewhere:void_scale_elytra: Elytra and chest armor in one (6 armor, 2 toughness, 864 durability). Weaker than a netherite chestplate, but you never have to swap.
How to get: Smithing: Aphelion's Void Scale, a netherite chestplate and an elytra.

How to get: Aphelion drops it (35%), Ossyra (10%).
elsewhere:wayfinder: Opens the Atlas, a screen that shows every dimension, its tier and its attunement recipe.

elsewhere:wayfinder_glasswaste: Opens a rift to the Glasswaste; use it there to go home. Reusable, 60 s cooldown shared by all Wayfinders.
How to get: Craft: a base Wayfinder in the middle with 2 gold ingots, 1 chiseled sandstone, 2 tinted glass, 2 cactus and 1 blaze powder.
elsewhere:wayfinder_greenhaze: Opens a rift to the Greenhaze; use it there to go home. Reusable, 60 s cooldown shared by all Wayfinders.
How to get: Craft: a base Wayfinder in the middle with 2 large ferns, 1 campfire, 2 honeycomb, 2 cocoa beans and 1 glow berries.
elsewhere:wayfinder_ironpeak: Opens a rift to Ironpeak; use it there to go home. Reusable, 60 s cooldown shared by all Wayfinders.
How to get: Craft: a base Wayfinder in the middle with 2 iron blocks, 1 goat horn, 2 packed ice, 2 spruce logs and 1 emerald.
elsewhere:wayfinder_pale_hollow: Opens a rift to the Pale Hollow; use it there to go home. Reusable, 60 s cooldown shared by all Wayfinders.
How to get: Craft: a base Wayfinder in the middle with 2 resin clumps, 1 open eyeblossom, 2 pale oak logs, 2 pale moss blocks and 1 bone block.
elsewhere:wayfinder_petalwind: Opens a rift to Petalwind Isles; use it there to go home. Reusable, 60 s cooldown shared by all Wayfinders.
How to get: Craft: a base Wayfinder in the middle with 2 feathers, 1 wind charge, 2 pink petals, 2 cherry saplings and 1 phantom membrane.
elsewhere:wayfinder_the_hush: Opens a rift to the Hush; use it there to go home. Reusable, 60 s cooldown shared by all Wayfinders.
How to get: Craft: a base Wayfinder in the middle with 2 echo shards, 1 sculk shrieker, 2 sculk catalysts, 2 disc fragments and 1 dragon's breath. Only after the Ender Dragon is dead.
The Hush attunement needs the Ender Dragon defeated first: see the "Wayfinder Attunement" page of this item.

elsewhere:windchime: Rings in the wind and nudges mobs away.
